headline: Senate tees up final votes on college sports rights bill while House takes a breather!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed six bills including the Critical Infrastructure Manufacturing Feasibility Act, New Mexico Land Grant-Mercedes Historical or Traditional Use Cooperation Act, and the Secure Space Act restricting satellite communications with entities on covered lists. The chamber also confirmed U.S. District Judge Angela Veronica Colmenero in a close 50-47 vote and agreed to multiple commemorative resolutions, including honoring former Arizona Senator Jon Llewellyn Kyl.
